common.selection: All f06/f07/f08 development observations at unfinished task and remaining=2. Both target slots, both roles, four mechanisms and three statuses.
common.scope_limit: 144 observations, 72 role pairs, 12 new identity pairs and three authored wording families. Timing/task variation and multi-entity realistic notices remain untested.

field_reference.purpose: Primary canonical role contrast versus direct canonical, reversed and fixed semantic-mean choices. Also report reversed and mean role contrasts.

explicit_identity.purpose: Strong prespecified baseline: literal process IDs in options, including the fixed semantic mean over both orders. Same role contrasts are also reported.

amendment: Before any transfer calls, add the strong literal-identity baseline exposed by the completed calibration format probe. No primary contrast equation, threshold or transfer examples change. Run both conditions unchanged and report all comparisons.
